abstract: Color Doppler sonography has replaced pelvic arteriography as well as real-time ultrasound in the assessment of patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. In about 25% of patients in whom human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) levels are suggestive of trophoblastic disease, there will be no evidence of abnormal vessels in the uterus. In these cases it is assumed that hCG was produced by metastatic lesions. We present here three cases in which color Doppler examination was negative and where myometrial biopsies containing tumor were obtained by means of hysteroscopy. The fact that color Doppler, in its present form, does not detect small areas of trophoblastic tumor might also have implications for other kinds of tumors. Knowledge of the exact microscopic diagnosis in molar patients with persistent disease may have an impact on management.
abstract_ja: カラードプラ超音波検査は、骨盤動脈造影や実時間超音波に代わり、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の評価に用いられるようになった。hCG値から絨毛性疾患が疑われる患者の約25%では、子宮内に異常血管を認めない。このような場合、hCGは転移巣によって産生されていると考えられている。本報告では、カラードプラ検査が陰性であった3例において、子宮鏡により腫瘍を含む子宮筋層生検を得た。現在の形式のカラードプラは微小な絨毛性腫瘍巣を検出できないことがあり、これは他の腫瘍においても意味を持ちうる。胞状奇胎患者で持続性疾患がみられる場合、正確な組織学的診断を知ることは管理に影響を与えうる。
